title: Disney Deals: Disneyland Paris, Disney World & Offers
description: How to save on Disneyland Paris, Walt Disney World and Disneyland California: official offers, under-3s free, multi-day tickets and the best times to go.
h1: Disney deals and offers for families
intro: A Disney trip is a big-ticket day out. Here’s how families in the UK, US and Europe can save on Disneyland Paris, Walt Disney World and the original Disneyland, using official offers only.

image.alt: Cinderella Castle reflected in the moat at Magic Kingdom

blocks.title: Scout’s Disney verdict
blocks.text: Disney rewards planning more than any other day out. Under-3s are free, multi-day tickets cut the cost per day, and quieter dates are cheaper. Skip “secret code” sites: real Disney offers appear on Disney’s own website.

items.title: Disneyland Paris

image.alt: Sleeping Beauty Castle at Disneyland Paris

items.text: Disneyland Park plus Disney Adventure World (the renamed Walt Disney Studios Park), where World of Frozen opened on 29 March 2026.
saves: Check the official offers page: Disneyland Paris often runs seasonal hotel and ticket offers
UK tour operators sometimes include free child places on packages
items.scout: Go for at least two days so you can do both parks without rushing. Frozen fans should head to World of Frozen early.

items.title: Walt Disney World Resort

image.alt: Cinderella Castle at Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World, Orlando

items.text: Four theme parks (Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios and Animal Kingdom) plus two water parks. It’s a holiday, not a day out, so plan several days.
saves: Children under 3 don’t need a park ticket
Multi-day tickets cost less per day than single days
Check Disney’s official special offers page before booking
items.scout: Don’t try to do it all. Two parks done well beat four done in a rush, especially with little ones.

items.title: Disneyland Resort

image.alt: A fairy-tale castle lit up at night

items.text: The original Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure sit side by side, so it’s easier to tackle in two or three days than Florida.
saves: Multi-day tickets lower the cost per day
Southern California residents sometimes get special ticket offers: check Disney’s offers page
items.scout: The two parks are a short walk apart, so a park hopper ticket is easy to use here.

blocks.title: Official Disney offers
blocks.intro: There are no secret Disney discount codes. These official offer pages and rules are where the real savings are:

items.title: Seasonal hotel and ticket offers
items.text: Disneyland Paris runs seasonal offers on its official site. Under-3s always go free.
items.nocode: No code: offers apply when you book
items.terms: Offer dates, eligible hotels and conditions vary.

items.title: Official special offers and free kids’ dining deals
items.text: Disney lists current ticket and hotel offers on its official site, and some 2026 UK packages have included free dining for children aged 3–9.
items.nocode: No code: offers apply when you book
items.terms: Offers have limited dates and conditions.

sections.html:
• Under-3s go free at Disneyland Paris, Walt Disney World and Disneyland Resort.
  • Buy more days. At the US parks the price per day drops the more days you buy.
  • Avoid peak dates. School holidays, Christmas and Halloween weekends cost the most.
  • Compare packages. Hotel-and-ticket packages sometimes include extras like free dining for children. Compare them with booking separately.
  • Buy from Disney or an authorised seller. Unofficial tickets can be invalid.

Turning it into a holiday? Compare Orlando holidays on TravelDeals.
At Disneyland Paris, the second park was renamed Disney Adventure World, and World of Frozen opened on 29 March 2026. Read what’s new at Disneyland Paris.

faqs.a: Disney doesn’t generally publish public discount codes. Genuine offers are listed on Disney’s official websites and apply when you book eligible dates and packages. Be wary of websites promising secret codes.

faqs.q: Do children under 3 need a Disney ticket?
faqs.a: No. Children under 3 go free at Disneyland Paris, Walt Disney World and Disneyland Resort.

faqs.q: How many days do you need at Walt Disney World?
faqs.a: With four theme parks, most families plan at least four park days, and the price per day falls as you add days. Disneyland Paris and Disneyland Resort each have two parks, so two to three days works well.
